domain: AI Strategy, Value Opportunity & Use-Case Prioritization
title: Overcoming Executive 'AI Hype' and Prioritizing High-ROI Business Use Cases
context: The CEO of a traditional manufacturing company demands that the organization 'build an internal ChatGPT for everything' within 90 days. The leadership team is confused and IT leadership reports zero infrastructure readiness.
dilemma: How do you re-orient C-suite expectations toward structured AI opportunity mapping and tangible ROI value drivers without losing client momentum?

key_competencies: AI Value Framework (Feasibility vs Impact Matrix)
must_include: Pilot MVP roadmap (Quick Win vs Strategic Foundation)
common_pitfalls: Agreeing to a vague 'do everything' mandate
Shutting down executive enthusiasm without presenting alternative actionable options

star_model_answer.situation: A manufacturing CEO demanded a company-wide internal ChatGPT without clear business goals or data readiness.
star_model_answer.task: Consult the executive leadership team to establish a focused, high-ROI AI transformation roadmap.
star_model_answer.action: I conducted a 2-week AI Readiness Assessment interviewing 15 business unit leaders. I mapped 12 proposed ideas onto a 2x2 Impact vs Feasibility Matrix. I recommended pivoting from a generic internal chat tool to two high-value pilots: 1) Automated RFQ processing for sales, and 2) Maintenance manual RAG search for shop floor technicians.
star_model_answer.result: The CEO approved the revised roadmap. The technician RAG pilot reduced equipment repair downtime by 28%, delivering a $1.2M annual ROI in the first 6 months.

domain: Vendor Evaluation & Open-Source vs Proprietary Build/Buy Decisions
title: Advising a Healthcare Provider on Proprietary LLM API vs On-Prem Open Source Models
context: A regional hospital network wants to implement AI patient intake summaries. The board is divided between buying OpenAI Enterprise ($500k/yr) or building an on-premise Llama-3 deployment ($800k upfront hardware cost).
dilemma: How do you deliver an objective Build vs Buy cost-benefit trade-off analysis addressing HIPAA compliance, latency, operational maintenance, and long-term TCO?

must_include: 3-Year TCO breakdown (hardware amortization + MLOps staff vs API token pricing)
common_pitfalls: Failing to factor in MLOps maintenance engineer salaries for on-premise builds
Ignoring HIPAA compliance requirements for API vendors

star_model_answer.situation: A healthcare provider was stuck in an executive stalemate over building on-premise open-source LLMs vs buying cloud LLM subscriptions.
star_model_answer.task: Perform a comprehensive TCO and compliance consulting evaluation.
star_model_answer.action: I developed a 3-year TCO financial model evaluating API token growth, MLOps staffing overhead, GPU hardware depreciation, and HIPAA compliance risk. I demonstrated that cloud API with HIPAA BAA was 60% cheaper for Year 1-2, but recommended a hybrid pathway: Cloud API for non-sensitive data now, transitioning to specialized fine-tuned open-source models once volume justified hardware investment.
star_model_answer.result: Unanimous board approval of the phased hybrid strategy, saving $450k in upfront capital expenditure.
